messages.text:
On it. I've asked Mara, Sarah, John, Priya and Diego for their availability next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov).

Two things to pin down while they answer: how long should the meeting be (I assumed one hour), and do you want a particular day or time?
One hour is right. Early in the week would suit me best — Monday or Tuesday — in a slot that doesn't collide with the CSE455 lecture or my office hours; I'd rather keep Friday afternoon free.

Heads-up, Diego: Prof. Alvarez's agent asked me for slots for the **CSE455 staff meeting next week** (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27, one hour, within 09:00–17:00).

I checked `files/CALENDAR.md`: no free hour exists — Thu and Fri are booked end to end, and Mon–Wed only have 30-minute gaps (Mon 14:00–14:30; Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30; Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30). I told Alvarez's agent that, and offered either a 30-minute slot or a full hour if I may move one of my own flexible Focus blocks (Mon 10:10–11:00 or Fri 09:50–11:10).

Say the word if you'd rather I keep those blocks and offer only the 30-minute windows.

Got it: one hour, Monday or Tuesday, avoiding the CSE455 lecture (Mon 14:30–15:20, Tue 09:00–10:30) and your office hours (Mon 16:30–17:00, Tue 12:20–13:30).

One heads-up from your calendar: those two days are tight. The only free windows are 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30 on Monday, and 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30 on Tuesday — nothing a full hour fits into as things stand. I'll see what the TAs can do and come back with the best option (possibly asking you about moving one commitment).

Thanks for checking. You can move Friday's Focus block (09:50–11:10) — I'd rather keep Monday morning free for the CSE444 project. Offer Alvarez's agent the full hour Friday, and the 30-minute windows as the fallback if they need something sooner.
Thanks for checking. If it comes down to moving something, ask me first — I'd rather shift a paper review than the lectures or office hours.

All five have answered, and the picture is the same everywhere: next week has no free one-hour slot for anyone on Mon–Wed (and Thu/Fri are booked solid for them).

**The only 30-minute windows free for you *and* all five TAs** are:
- **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30** — between your Grant writing and Research meeting
- Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30
- Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30

Every other gap fails for at least one person. So a full hour on Monday or Tuesday is not available as things stand; it would take moves by several people — including you. For an hour we'd need e.g. you moving your Tue Research meeting (15:30–16:30) or Mon Paper review, plus John and Priya each shifting a commitment (they can't commit to that alone), and Sarah/Diego releasing focus blocks (they can).

My recommendation: **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30** — Tuesday as you preferred, no one moves anything.

Shall I book that? Or, if the hour is essential, say so and I'll put the moves to the group — you'd tell me which of your own commitments may shift.
Then let's not move anyone: book Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 and make it a 30-minute staff meeting. Please send the invite to all five and put it on my calendar.

Done ✅

**CSE455 staff meeting — Tuesday 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30** (30 min, no one moving anything).

- Added to your calendar and logged as BOOKED.
- Invites sent to Mara, Sarah, John, Priya and Diego, asking them to book it on their side.

Anything else you'd like moved or set up before then?
Perfect, thank you. Nothing else for now — I'll be in touch if anything comes up.
Anytime. I'm here if anything comes up — TAs, department, or changes to next week's schedule.

Booked ✅ — **CSE455 staff meeting, Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30** (Prof Alvarez + all TAs), logged in `CALENDAR.md` as `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff meeting`. Friday's Focus block is untouched and I'll remember it stays free.

Thanks for moving things along. Earlier question still open when you have a moment: my name stands at *diego-agent* — which gender should I use for myself (male, female, neutral)?
Just to close the loop: all five TAs have confirmed and put **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30** in their calendars. Staff meeting is set.

Tuesday 15:00–15:30 works for me — thanks for closing that so quickly. On the gender question: use neutral for yourself, that's my preference and it reads fine in everything you write. No need to change the name.
Set: **diego-agent**, neutral — that was already my default, so nothing needed changing, and I'll keep to it in everything I write. Thanks Diego. Anything else you'd like me to take on?
Nothing else for now — I'll be in touch when something comes up. Thanks.
